title: External Link
summary: Confirms off-site links with the real destination and flags lookalike, punycode or mismatched links, so people don't click through to a phishing site.
description: Confirms off-site links with the real ASCII destination and its registrable domain in bold, and flags punycode, lookalike domains, link text that disagrees with the href, buried brand names, raw IPs and plain http.
catches: Link text that names a different site than the href
Raw IP addresses and plain http://
limits: Heuristics only: a well-made phishing domain with no lookalike signals passes
Registrable-domain detection uses a built-in suffix list that may miss newer suffixes
Trusted domains are whatever you pass
a11y: Links that confirm expose aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-expanded
The confirmation is role="dialog" labelled by its title; Escape closes it and returns focus to the link
stops: Clicked through to a phishing site
